input.change_text: *(rmcp-macros)* use re-exported serde_json path in task_handler ([#735](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk/pull/735))

output.subject: rmcp-macros task_handler routes through re-exported serde_json
output.action_text: Upgrade `rmcp-macros` to 1.2.0+ if your crate uses `task_handler` without a direct `serde_json` dependency. The macro now resolves `serde_json` through the re-exported path, removing the need for callers to add `serde_json` to their `Cargo.toml`.
